entities.title: Gambit
entities.summary: 3D chess for the browser, made in Godot 4: play a friend by email invitation at your own pace, with chat, or Stockfish at eight strengths; every game is kept and can be replayed.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot client in godot/, the page bridge in bridge/, the TypeScript shared by the Worker and its tests in shared/, the Cloudflare Worker in worker/, the page's static files in web/, the TypeScript tests in test/, the reference-render scripts in scripts/, and Gambit's own design documents in docs/. It is one npm project, built by build.mjs and deployed as one Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/ and the login service, neither edited here.
Unlike the other games it has no TypeScript engine and no high-score table.
docs/ is the design to build from; the .dev files link to it rather than copy it.
